title: 滴答计时器
problem_statement_md:
编写一个**定时器**程序，它应该计算得到一个指定的数字。
你的程序需要接受一个数字作为输入，并使**定时器**跳动指定次数。

main中的代码初始化了一个**Timer**，并将一个数字作为输入。
然后调用**Timer**的`tick()`方法，让计时器跳动指定次数。

请定义**Timer**结构体，有两个字段：**id**和**value**，并定义**tick**()方法，该方法应将**value**递增1，并输出当前值。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Ticking Timer[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are building a [b]Timer[/b] app that should count up to a given number.
Your program needs to take a number as input and make the [b]Timer[/b] tick that number of times.

The code in main initializes a [b]Timer[/b] and takes a number as input. Then it calls the [b]tick[/b]() method for the [b]Timer[/b] the given number of times.

Define the [b]Timer[/b] struct with two fields: [b]id[/b] and [b]value[/b], and define the [b]tick[/b]() method, which should increment the [b]value[/b] by one and output its current value.
[note]Use a[b] struct pointer [/b]as the method's receiver to be able to change the [b]value[/b] of the Timer.[/note]
hint_md: 使用一个**结构体指针**作为该方法的接收者参数，以便能够改变定时器的**value**值。
